summary:
I wrote no tests for GLOSS.curses because the whole unit is outside the implemented subset.

- **Why it's out of scope:** spec §1.2 (`docs/dnd-golden-scenarios-srd521.md`) excludes "Curses and magical contagions" and "sentient or cursed items". Nothing in scope (the 32 spells, 14 monsters or 7 magic items) puts a curse on anything. Remove Curse and Greater Restoration are level 3 and level 5 spells, above the level-2 limit. Lesser Restoration is in scope but doesn't end curses, and a test of that would need a curse to exist first. Per CLAUDE.md, out-of-scope content gets no tests, so all three clauses are recorded as `out-of-scope` with no infra tickets.
- **Stage B:** all four verdicts are "not-related" (the code lines only share page 179), so no scenario changes are needed.
- **Rulings:** stage A's two ambiguities (Dispel Magic ending a curse that a spell conferred, and the removal spells' own limits) don't affect any test now, so I proposed no rulings. They should be decided when curses come into scope.
- **Abuse catalogue:** I added two cheats under "Spells and effects" in `loop/abuse-catalogue.md`:
  - ending a curse with magic that doesn't explicitly end curses, or getting more from Remove Curse or Greater Restoration than their own text gives;
  - shedding a curse by shape-shifting or by changing a cursed item's owner.
- **Files:** that catalogue edit is my only change.
